name: Robe of the Archmagi

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

summary: AC 15 + Dex without armor, Advantage on saves against spells, and +2 to your spell save DC and spell attacks.
text: A finely woven, rune-covered robe that grants three benefits to its wearer. With no armor on, your base Armor Class becomes 15 + your Dexterity modifier. Saving throws you make against spells and any other magical effect have Advantage. Your spell attack bonus and spell save DC both rise by 2.
